commentary.text: 90+5' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) attempts to put in the resulting set piece, but he miskicks and sends the ball into the stands. A strong but inaccurate shot.
90+4' Ibou Sane (Metz) handles the ball inside the penalty area. Lyon earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+3' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+2' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Substitution. Kevin Van Den Kerkhof makes way for Fali Cande (Metz).
89' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
88' Ablie Jallow goes off the pitch and Kevin N'Doram (Metz) comes on.
84' 1 - 1 Skelly Alvero (Lyon) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
81' Fabio Grosso has decided to substitute Clinton Mata and he is replaced by Jeffinho (Lyon).
81' Ibou Sane (Metz) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Millot blows for a foul.
80' None of the Lyon players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.

79' That's unlucky! Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
77' 0 - 1 Goal! Ablie Jallow (Metz) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and fires a brilliant shot that goes in off the left post.
76' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ernest Nuamah (Lyon). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
73' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' A lofted cross from Ibou Sane (Metz) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee blows his whistle, Metz are awarded a corner kick.
70' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) replacing Joel Asoro.
70' Substitution. Simon Elisor walks off the pitch and Ibou Sane (Metz) comes on as a substitute.
69' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
68' Lamine Camara (Metz) sends a direct effort from the free kick. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
67' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Millot saw the whole situation. Metz are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
65' The Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee Benoit Millot rules it out for a foul.
63' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
60' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Metz.
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mahamadou Diawara walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon).
58' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Rayan Cherki (Lyon) replaces Mama Balde.
57' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
51' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.
51' Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

50' Skelly Alvero (Lyon) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Gillaume Dietsch makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal. Good work from Lyon as they win a corner.
49' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
48' Joel Asoro (Metz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Metz earn a corner.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Lamine Camara (Metz) launches a cross from the corner, but Anthony Lopes is alert to thwart the effort.
45+5' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Metz.
45+4' Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
45+1' A wild pass somehow finds Skelly Alvero (Lyon) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
45' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Lamine Camara (Metz) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
44' Benoit Millot couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mahamadou Diawara (Lyon) and blew his whistle.
43' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner but it's cleared.

42' What a sweet touch by Ablie Jallow (Metz) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him! The ball is out of play. Metz win a corner kick.
41' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

40' A sweet pass finds Ablie Jallow (Metz) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Anthony Lopes is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
37' The corner from Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is intercepted by Gillaume Dietsch.
36' Lamine Camara (Metz) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
35' Matthieu Udol (Metz) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee points to the corner flag and Metz will take a corner.
33' Metz keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
30' Maxime Colin (Metz) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
28' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Metz, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
27' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Benoit Millot signals.

25' Simon Elisor (Metz) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Anthony Lopes was alert and the score remained the same.
23' Lamine Camara (Metz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon have a free kick.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' Clinton Mata (Lyon) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Millot has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick to Metz.
19' Sinaly Diomande (Lyon) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
18' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gillaume Dietsch (Metz) is coming onto the pitch as Alexandre Oukidja cannot continue after picking up an injury.
15' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
12' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' The game is interrupted as Mama Balde (Lyon) is flagged offside.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
6' Simon Elisor (Metz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Metz.
5' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
3' Metz fail to score from a corner as Anthony Lopes (Lyon) leaps to collect the ball.
2' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
1' Great save! Mama Balde (Lyon) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Alexandre Oukidja.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
Benoit Millot will referee today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
